instagram.caption:
Thanksgiving is a month away, and in Wellesley and Needham that means game 139 is coming. Swipe to see how a booster club turns it into a fundraiser.

Make a free 100 square board, type in Wellesley and Needham, and send the link to families and alumni. Half the pot goes to the winner and half goes to your group.

Free to create, and we never touch the money. Link in bio.

Save this and send it to your booster president.
